caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular composition bordered with a brown frame. Inside, there is an arrangement of large and small stylized flowers and circular lace-like patterns scattered across a beige background. The flowers are colored in bright and varied shades, including red, yellow, orange, pink, blue, and green. Leaves and stems are depicted in multiple shades of green, intertwining and curling around the flowers. Several blue and red flowers are prominent, and some of the petals have intricate detailing with lines or patterns. At the bottom center, there is a pillow-shaped design outlined in yellow with red zigzag and stitched lines, featuring small decorative flowers around it. The name "ELIZA" along with the text "AGED 17 1796 NEEDLEER" is stitched below this central pillow shape. The upper middle features a small red bow. The overall arrangement is symmetrical and densely filled with floral and lace-like circular motifs, with no visible empty spaces within the central bordered area.
title: Embroidered Sampler
